messages:
hema: FYI customers reporting duplicate SSE chunks after reconnects, billing spike on na-east routes.

liam: any repro steps?

hema: quick: open SSE -> get id `e-9` -> idle disconnect -> client reconnects with Last-Event-ID: e-9 -> server sends 204 + proxy also replays cached chunk -> client sees e-9 twice.

sara: sounds like race: resume-check vs cached fanout. proxy probably forwards cache while control-plane still reconciling lease.

ops-bot: ALERT: na-east stream token-usage +320% in 10m. tag=last-event-resume.

liam: short-term: strip Last-Event-ID on proxy when lease lookup misses. low risk flag.

hema: that should stop replay handshake. also add metric streaming.resume_dup_pct and alert >0.5%/10m.

sara: add log: RESUME_STRIP reason=lease_miss route=%s last_id=%s.

deploy-bot: canary pause possible if error budget increases.

liam: long-term: unify resume.mode config (strict|optimistic|replay-with-dedupe). console should show mode per-route.

hema: ok assign to liam for PR. timeline: PR today, canary with flag off by default tomorrow.

liam: will also add billing tag billing.cause=resume_replay so finance can filter dup charges.

sara: collect 10 traces of affected reconnects for postmortem.

ops-bot: TICKET PLAT-10221 created "strip Last-Event-ID on lease miss + telemetry" assigned to liam.

hema: thanks — watching the dashboard after canary.
